name: hoox
description: 可靠、可恢复、可审计的多租户 Agent Runtime

scripts.config:check: node scripts/validate-env-example.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env.example -f docker-compose.dev.yml config --quiet
scripts.db:setup: corepack pnpm db:roles:bootstrap && corepack pnpm db:migrate:up
scripts.dev:identity:provision: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/api^... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/api dev:identity:provision
scripts.dev:admin-control:api: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/admin-control-api... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/admin-control-api dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/api^... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/api dev
scripts.dev:scheduler: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/scheduler^... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/scheduler dev
scripts.dev:worker: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/agent-worker^... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/agent-worker dev
scripts.dev:worker:check: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/agent-worker^... build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/agent-worker dev:preflight
scripts.test:integration:m4: corepack pnpm build:m4-runtime-dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/postgres-run-worker.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:process-runtime: corepack pnpm build:process-runtime-dependencies && vitest run runtime-ts/packages/process-runtime/src runtime-ts/apps/api/src/process-entry.test.ts runtime-ts/apps/agent-worker/src/process-entry.test.ts runtime-ts/apps/scheduler/src/process-entry.test.ts runtime-ts/apps/admin-control-api/src/process-entry.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --recursive --sort --if-present typecheck
scripts.typecheck:built: tsc -p tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --recursive --sort --if-present typecheck:built && corepack pnpm --filter @cubesandbox/sdk typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm toolchain:check && corepack pnpm admin:pi-catalog:check && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm typecheck:built && corepack pnpm test:built && corepack pnpm config:check
scripts.dev:trajectory: corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/trajectory build && corepack pnpm --filter @hoox/trajectory-web build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env runtime-ts/apps/trajectory-web/dist/bin.js
